details: The 21shares Canton Network ETF (TCAN) debuted on Nasdaq, becoming the first U.S. ETF to offer direct exposure to Canton Coin. The Canton Network is a privacy-preserving blockchain ecosystem designed for institutional finance, with major firms like Goldman Sachs and Microsoft backing its core developer, Digital Asset. This launch signals a growing trend of institutional interest in tokenized assets.
title: 21Shares Launches First US Canton Network ETF on Nasdaq

details: CME Group has introduced new futures contracts for Avalanche (AVAX) and Sui (SUI), with initial trades executed by FalconX and G-20 Group. This expansion provides regulated products for managing price risk and exploring opportunities in a wider range of altcoins, indicating increasing institutional interest beyond just Bitcoin.
title: CME Group Launches Avalanche and Sui Cryptocurrency Futures Trading

details: American Bitcoin Corp (ABTC) reported Q1 2026 revenue of $62.1 million, a 20.7% decline from the previous quarter, primarily due to Bitcoin price drops. However, the company successfully grew its strategic Bitcoin reserve to over 7,000 BTC (a 30% increase), maintained a 52% mining gross margin, and reduced mining costs, demonstrating strong operational efficiency despite market headwinds.
title: American Bitcoin Reports Q1 2026 Results: Revenue Dip, Bitcoin Holdings Grow

details: Payward, the parent company of crypto exchange Kraken, has agreed to acquire Hong Kong-based Reap Technologies for up to $600 million in cash and stock. This strategic acquisition aims to expand Payward's business-to-business (B2B) infrastructure platform, specifically targeting card issuance and stablecoin payments in the Asian market.
title: Crypto Exchange Kraken Snags Reap Technologies For $600 Million

details: Glassnode data indicates that Bitcoin whales on Hyperliquid, a prominent on-chain perpetuals exchange, have significantly increased their net long positions, reaching a new high for 2026. Total whale positions are approximately $3.5 billion, with long positions slightly outnumbering shorts, reflecting a bullish market sentiment and recent short liquidations.
title: Bitcoin Whales on Hyperliquid Push Net Long Positions to 2026 High

details: Fundstrat co-founder Tom Lee believes that recent technical action in the crypto market signals the emergence of a new bull market. He highlighted Bitcoin's rebound above $80,000 and robust institutional interest, with spot Bitcoin ETFs continuing to attract substantial inflows. Lee suggests that many investors are currently underestimating the strength of this ongoing rebound.
title: Tom Lee Says Rare Signal Points to Crypto Bull Market

details: Bitcoin Cash (BCH) experienced a 1.2% decline, contributing to a 0.2% decrease in the CoinDesk 20 Index, which was trading at 2171.96. While the majority of assets within the index were performing positively, BCH was noted as a significant laggard.
title: Bitcoin Cash Drops, Leading CoinDesk 20 Index Lower

details: The White House is pushing for the passage of the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (CLARITY Act) by July 4, 2026. This proposed legislation aims to provide much-needed regulatory clarity for the crypto market, specifically defining which tokens fall under the jurisdiction of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) versus the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The proposed timeline includes Senate action in May-June and a House vote before Independence Day.
title: White House Targets July 4 for US Crypto Law Passage
